Dutt's prose English Harivamsha appeared in 1897 as the Mahabharata's supplement. Harivamsha means the lineage of Hari, a name of Vishnu as Krishna. The work tells Krishna's full story, from birth to the age's dark close.

The supplement rounds out the great epic's most loved god's tale. Genealogy and myth blend in a warm, storyteller's flow throughout. govdocs-archive_org-nsia-TobiasRichardMo:
Richard Tobias studied the autopsy photographs from President Kennedy's post-mortem examination and reached a stark conclusion. His monograph argues, on ballistic grounds, that four shots came from the front. That claim runs against the Warren Commission, which placed the shots behind the president.

Tobias builds his case from the photographs themselves, treating wounds and angles as physical evidence a reader can check. Works like this one kept the forensic debate alive outside official channels. For students of the assassination, it is a clear example of how independent researchers used the medical record to challenge the government's account.
